title: Replica-Aware Validation of Machine Learning for Reliable Interpretation of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories: Cav3.1 Reproducibility Package
description: Revision 3 processed-data and analysis update. Includes the nine C-alpha-distance matrices, missing RMSD descriptors, original exploratory distance features and frame metadata, portable pairing-invariance/tICA/classifier/uncertainty/network sensitivity workflows, auxiliary contact/COM/torsion/MMGBSA/hydration inputs, pinned Python 3.10 dependencies, and independent numerical validation. Production trajectories are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. Code MIT; data and documentation CC BY 4.0. Exact schematic artwork and molecular-rendering scenes are separate from numerical reproduction.
